title: DAO SoulMate — Missing Access Control (Unrestricted `redeem` Call) Analysis
loss_raw: ~$319,000 (entire asset holdings of BUI index token drained)
root_cause: No access control (e.g., `ownerOnly` or whitelist) on the `redeem()` function — any arbitrary address can burn the Vault's entire BUI balance and receive the underlying component assets
steps: BUI burned → 0x000 Component assets → attack contract
